skills.name: /list-it
skills.description: collect action items in a running list; build only when you explicitly ask to execute

skills.name: /explore
skills.description: a thinking-out-loud sandbox that runs parallel to your working list without mixing context; topics stay undecided by definition

skills.name: /mock-it
skills.description: explore multiple visual iterations in the same chat window without having to click a link to review a detailed artifact

skills.name: /park-it
skills.description: park explored decisions with context for later; summon the backlog when you're ready to tackle it

skills.name: /design-eval
skills.description: audit a component, a page, or an entire flow against your design system; resolve inconsistencies, add new components, styles or variants
